claim: Octo Health raised a 2.7 million euro pre-seed round.
The pre-seed round was led by 3xP Global.
Octo Health is based in Lisbon.
Octo Health's platform offers clinical testing for more than 110 biomarkers.
In Portugal, Octo Health costs from 8 euros a month.
The package with tests starts at 199 euros a year, according to Jornal Económico.
Octo Health announced its launch in Portugal and the United States on 4 November.
Catarina Kemper is the founder and CEO of Octo Health.
